settings.question: Do I need to be technical?
settings.answer: No. If you can write an email and use a spreadsheet, you can do every lesson. Module one starts from the very beginning.

settings.question: Which AI tools do I need?
settings.answer: One general chat assistant, free or paid, and the tools you already use for email and files. Every lesson says when a paid plan is worth it.

settings.question: Is my customers’ data safe?
settings.answer: Module one covers what never to paste into a chat, how to turn off training on your data and how to write a simple AI policy for your team.

settings.question: Will this work for my kind of business?
settings.answer: It is built for service businesses, shops, agencies and consultants. If most of your week is writing, answering, organising or researching, it fits.

settings.question: Can I pay in parts?
settings.answer: Yes. Every edition can be paid in full or in three monthly parts at checkout.

settings.question: What is the refund policy?
settings.answer: Do the first two modules. If it is not saving you time, write within 30 days and you get your money back.

settings.question: Do you invoice businesses?
settings.answer: Yes. The receipt shows your business name and tax number, and the team edition comes with one invoice.

settings.question: How long do I have access?
settings.answer: For as long as the course runs, including every update and new lesson.

settings.question: How much time does it take?
settings.answer: About two hours a week for six weeks. Lessons are short, and each ends with one thing to set up in your business.

settings.question: When are the live calls?
settings.answer: Thursdays at 6pm UK time for the cohort edition, recorded and posted the same evening. Change this to your own schedule.
